description: This file contains utility functions for working with Metal API in the TensorFlow Lite GPU delegate, including creating compute programs, handling textures, and encoding/decoding data. It integrates Metal shader compilation, pipeline creation, and buffer operations for GPU acceleration.

methods.name: GetBestSupportedMetalDevice
methods.description: Returns the default supported Metal device on the system.

methods.name: CreateComputeProgram
methods.description: Creates a Metal compute pipeline program from shader code, function name, and macros.

methods.name: CreateComputeProgramWithArgumentBuffer
methods.description: Creates a compute pipeline with support for argument buffers, returning both the pipeline state and argument encoder.

methods.name: CreateComputeProgramWithICBSupport
methods.description: Creates a compute pipeline with support for indirect command buffers, returning the pipeline state and argument encoder.
